## Analysis Tab

Analysis is the global analysis setting which meters utilize for calculations. They are datetime effective and are used to warn the user when a meter analysis is imported for the meter that does not match the known master analysis.

<div class="procedure">

To create a master analysis:

1.  Select the **Analysis** tab and click **New**.
2.  Check the **Compare to Analysis** option. When checked, the meter analysis will be compared to the master analysis on import. If unchecked, validations against the master analysis will not occur.
3.  Enter the **Effective From** and **Effective To** dates, which defines the dates for which the master analysis will be effective. There can be multiple master analysis for any meter, but their date ranges will not overlap. If the date range of a master analysis is set so that it overlaps an existing master analysis, the existing analysis will be modified (or deleted if the new analysis completely overlaps the existing analysis) so that there is no overlap.
4.  Flag fields of interest by checking **Compare** or **Autocreate**.
    1.  When **Compare** is checked, FLOWCAL will compare the master analysis against the meter analysis imported. If the values differ from one another, then an exception will be generated.
    2.  When **Autocreate** is checked, the existing master analysis record will be split at the date of the new meter analysis containing the new value for that field. This will help keep the Master Analysis up-to-date and minimize the number of exceptions generated when a new meter analysis is imported.
5.  Click **OK** to save.
